create_wav2vec2_asr_model: create a wav2vec2 ASR model from a Wav2Vec2AsrConfig using the factory function
create_model: create a complete wav2vec2 ASR model with encoder, frontend, masker, and final projection
create_encoder_frontend: create a wav2vec2 encoder frontend component from the factory using encoder config
create_masker: create a standard wav2vec2 masker with temporal and spatial masking parameters
create_final_projection: create a linear projection layer from model dim to target vocab size with Xavier init
